title: Enrolment
description: A target repo's .factory/config.yml, read from its default branch. It isn't part of the runner contract, so it has no contract_version.

setup.description: Run before explore, implement, review and smoke, e.g. `uv sync`.

test_paths.description: Globs for test files, e.g. tests/**. Review's fixes may touch them as well as the PR's own files.

tasks.description: The tasks enabled for this repo. Left out, every task is enabled. smoke is always enabled.

enabled.description: false: still polled and triggers are queued, but nothing is dispatched. Defaults to true.

timeouts.description: Per-task timeout overrides, in minutes. run.yml still caps them at 60.
